subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a supported TUI send/newline keybinding preference, or limit this issue to documenting current pi-tui newline behavior and fallbacks?
rationale: The dependency already provides Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline behavior, but adding a public TUI keybinding or config bridge would expand a compatibility-sensitive user preference surface.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Approve TUI Keybinding Bridge
options.body: Wire a supported keybinding/config path for Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preferences with focused docs and tests.

options.title: Close As Sufficient
options.body: Treat dependency-level multiline support as enough and decline additional docs/help/config work.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history and the prior issue review route the TUI docs/help/product-scope choice here.
